description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Condition 5c (Ecological Mitigation and Enhancement Plan) of planning permission ref. 10272/APP/2025/362, dated 08-04-2025 (Erection of part single, part two storey side/rear extensions. Alterations to roof form including dormers. Amendments to fenestrations. Demolition of the existing porch and garage.)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: For the avoidance of doubt, the Local Planning Authority confirms that parts (a), (b) and (d) of Condition 5 (Ecological Mitigation and Enhancement Plan) of planning permission ref. 10272/APP/2025/362 were discharged under application ref. 10272/APP/2025/1922. Part (c) has now been discharged under the present application. Accordingly, Condition 5 is fully discharged.
